name: tfenv
description: SHA256SUMS from the same host by default; PGP vs a repo-pinned HashiCorp key exists but is opt-in only.
limitations: AI-generated static source analysis. Confirm the affected version, platform, update channel, and cited control flow before relying on this classification.

later_review_audit.description: Targeted source read supports this narrow assessment: Default install checks SHA-256 from the same HashiCorp host; PGP verification is conditional on explicit user configuration.
limitations: The retained snapshot does not establish current released artifact behavior or upstream configuration.
Where verification is delegated to an external framework/package, that implementation was not vendored and remains unresolved.

original_evidence.text: | tfenv | https://github.com/tfutils/tfenv.git | de6ce2e / 2026-04-28 | Y | N | Y | https (`releases.hashicorp.com`), TLS enforced, no insecure flags found | N (default path); optional (opt-in PGP-signed SHA256SUMS) | Default: **hash (SHA256)** from a `SHASUMS` file fetched from the *same* host. Opt-in: **PGP signature** over that SHASUMS file, verified via `gpg`/`gpgv`/keybase | Default: server-supplied/same-endpoint. Opt-in: **pinned-in-repo** (`tfenv/share/hashicorp-keys.pgp`, shipped in the clone) for the `use-gpgv` path | `tfenv/libexec/tfenv-install:249` `TFENV_REMOTE=https://releases.hashicorp.com`; `:259-301` downloads `terraform_${version}_SHA256SUMS`; `:318-376` PGP verification only runs if the user has created `${TFENV_CONFIG_DIR}/use-gnupg` or `use-gpgv` (or has keybase following hashicorp) — **absent any of those, line 376 logs a warning and skips signature verification entirely**, falling through to plain SHA256 compare at `:380-397`; `tfenv/share/hashicorp-keys.pgp` (5.6KB OpenPGP pubkey, present in the clone) is the pinned trust root used by the `use-gpgv` path at `:346-350`. `log 'error'` (`tfenv/lib/bashlog.sh:154-160`) calls `exit 1`, so a checksum/signature failure is fatal, not silently ignored. |
